name: One Element Scroll
description: Editorial fashion scroll page where a single image element morphs and travels between placeholders in each section using GSAP Flip, with parallax columns, sliding titles and revealed images.
contents: Full-screen hero image that becomes the shared moving element
Centered title, column of images, three-line headline with inline images, side text block, tall text block, image grid and related cards row
behavior: One image is fitted to each section placeholder in turn through scrubbed GSAP Flip
Title spans slide in from alternating sides, inline images scale and fade in on scroll
Column and text parallax, related cards scale in from the center
Layout switches between stacked and side-by-side at 53em
editableByProps: All headline, paragraph and card text, links and images
Text, title, background, gradient and link hover colors
Flip duration and easing, scroll smoothing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which sections the moving image lands in

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Kills all ScrollTrigger instances on unmount
Loads the typekit font stylesheet into the document head
Each section is a full viewport height and the outro uses large vertical margins for scroll range
Moving image needs one data-step placeholder per stop, in page order
